question: 17. Does ____________ try to get you to watch him/her?

ask_yes_example.text: Please give me an example of how he/she would try to get you to watch him/her. (If parent does not give a 0 example below, ask each individually.)

items: Babble or make a noise to get you to watch what he/ she is doing?
Look at you to get praise or comment?
Keep looking to see if you are looking?
